import unreal,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(unreal.Paths.project_dir()).resolve(); report=json.loads((root/'Saved/MallBuild/import_report.json').read_text())
rows=[]
for row in report['meshes']:
    mesh=unreal.load_asset(row['path']); mats=[mesh.get_material(i).get_path_name() if mesh.get_material(i) else None for i in range(len(row['slots']))]
    rows.append({'mesh':row['path'],'materials':mats})
m=unreal.load_asset('/Game/Generated_Materials/M_Mall_pachira_aquatica_01_leaves')
x=unreal.find_object(m,'MaterialExpressionSubstrateShadingModels_0')
dirty=unreal.EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.get_dirty_content_packages()+unreal.EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.get_dirty_map_packages()
unreal.log(json.dumps({'missing_or_default_materials':[r for r in rows if any(p is None or 'WorldGridMaterial' in p for p in r['materials'])],'leaf_shading_override':str(x.get_editor_property('ShadingModelOverride')) if x else 'node_not_found','dirty_mall_packages':[p.get_name() for p in dirty if '/Environment/Mall/' in p.get_name() or '/Generated_Materials/M_Mall' in p.get_name()],'other_dirty_count':len(dirty)}))
